subject.title: fix: preserve BOOTSTRAP.md in preseeded workspaces (#91931)

question: Should a workspace with `BOOTSTRAP.md` present and no `setupCompletedAt` remain pending unless memory content appears or the file is explicitly deleted, even when profile files or workspace skills are customized?
rationale: The branch fixes silent first-run onboarding loss, but intentionally removes profile and skill evidence from a previously supported stale-bootstrap repair path for existing workspaces.

options.title: Accept the narrowed rule
options.body: Treat the pending bootstrap file and unset setup state as authoritative, document the rule, and merge after focused validation.

options.title: Require an explicit mode
options.body: Preserve the legacy evidence heuristic by default and introduce a maintainer-approved managed-workspace mode with upgrade documentation and tests.

options.title: Pause this fix
options.body: Keep the linked bug open while maintainers define another completion signal that distinguishes operator preseed data from completed onboarding.

recommendation.title: Accept the narrowed rule
recommendation.body: Treat the pending bootstrap file and unset setup state as authoritative, document the rule, and merge after focused validation.

likelyOwner.reason: The behavior appears to originate in this contributor's stale-bootstrap repair work, making them the strongest history-based routing candidate for the compatibility decision.
